name: Kody Steele
summary: A jiu-jitsu black belt out of Syndicate MMA (8-1 in our data) who went 6-0 in Fury FC, won his Contender Series fight with a body shot and is 1-1 in the UFC. He is a willing, fan-friendly brawler who calls himself a grappler first; his debut loss to Rongzhu came when he abandoned the game plan to slug.

how_they_fight.Striking: Aggressive and hittable: he will stand and trade, which earned a Fight of the Night against Rongzhu but cost him a 30-27 decision. Has real body punching: he stopped Chasen Blair with a body shot in round two of the Contender Series after scoring a knockdown (our data).
how_they_fight.Grappling: The strength. Forceful takedown inside the first minute against Dom Mar Fan, a choke threat from half guard, mount, and when Fan reversed him he went to the legs and finished with a heel hook at 3:56 of round one (our data; BJPenn.com lists 3:53). Comfortable in leg-lock scrambles.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped. His only loss is a decision. Defensive striking is the weak point: he took heavy volume from Rongzhu and said he got caught up in the moment.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has gone 15 hard minutes in a firefight (Rongzhu). In our data his six finishes came two in round one, three in round two and one in round three (Alejandro Martinez at 2:09), so he finishes at any point and does not fade badly. His two decision wins were early in his career.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Confident and opportunistic on the ground ("When I saw it, I just had to take it"), but his own words after the Zhu loss show he can be drawn into brawls that suit the other man.

patterns: Early takedown attempt, then hunts for submissions
Never finished; only loss a unanimous decision
concerns: Withdrew from an August 2026 bout with Gauge Young at UFC Sacramento, reason undisclosed (RotoWire, citing Heavy)
Age 31 with only two UFC fights
Record discrepancy: Cageside said 10-2 after the Fan win; our data and AgentMMA have 8-1, and he has only one known pro loss
keys_to_beat: Keep it standing and out-volume him, as Rongzhu did
Stuff the first takedown and don't follow him into leg entanglements
Don't get reversed into scrambles where he attacks legs
Make him chase on the feet so he abandons the grappling

news.text: Booked against Noah Gugnon at lightweight on the UFC 333 prelims.
Out of an Aug. 22 bout with Gauge Young at UFC Sacramento, reason unclear; Young instead faced Stan Dorsainvil. Heavy says the withdrawal was injury-related.
First UFC win: heel hook of Road to UFC winner Dom Mar Fan in round one at UFC Perth.
